_comment: Conformance cases for parse_jwt_ticket, taken from rail-center's api/tests/vectors/signed_tickets.json at 0485959. Headers are that file's, verbatim; the last 12 cases are this reader's own, signed with the same key, whose seed that file publishes. A valid case's token is the payload as sent. A case's reader, where given, replaces the file's: holds_keys false is an empty key set, and a null issuer or audience is one not configured. Cases about requiring signatures, which the runtime decides, are removed. The keys sign nothing but these cases.

cases.name: a ticket signed with a key the reader holds, for its tenant, is valid
a payload changed after signing is bad_signature, whatever it now claims
a payload that is not JSON behind a signature that fails is bad_signature: it is never decoded
a ticket naming a held kid but signed with another key is bad_signature
a kid the reader holds no key for is bad_signature
a reader holding no key set reads every signed ticket as bad_signature
alg none is bad_signature, not an unsigned ticket
an alg other than EdDSA is bad_signature
alg is compared exactly: eddsa is not EdDSA
a header with no kid is bad_signature
a kid that is not a string is bad_signature
a header carrying crit is bad_signature
typ is ignored: a header with none is read like any other
a jku in the header is ignored: the key comes from the reader's own set
a jwk beside a held kid is ignored: a ticket signed with the key it carries is bad_signature
a jwk naming the held kid as its own is ignored: the reader's key for that kid is the only one
a jwk beside a kid the reader holds no key for is ignored: bad_signature
a jwk naming an unheld kid as its own is ignored: the reader holds no key for that kid
a jwk at a reader holding no key set is bad_signature: the header never stands in for the set
a jwk in a header with no kid does not rescue it: bad_signature
a jwk beside a kid that is not a string does not rescue it: bad_signature
two parts are undecodable
four parts are undecodable
an empty signature part is undecodable
a part outside the base64url alphabet is undecodable
a header that is not JSON is undecodable
a header that is a JSON array is undecodable
a payload that verifies but is not JSON is undecodable
an iss other than the reader's tenant's is wrong_audience
an aud other than the reader's tenant is wrong_audience
an aud given as a list is wrong_audience, even one holding the tenant
a ticket with no aud is wrong_audience
a reader configured with no issuer accepts no signed ticket
a reader configured with no issuer refuses a ticket carrying no iss: the two do not agree by both being absent
a reader configured with no audience accepts no signed ticket
a forged ticket at a reader with no issuer configured is bad_signature: the signature is checked first
an nbf 60 seconds ahead is within the allowance
an nbf 61 seconds ahead is wrong_audience
a signed ticket with no nbf is malformed
a fractional nbf is malformed
a signed ticket dead at exp is expired
audience is checked before expiry: expired and for another tenant is wrong_audience
shape is checked before audience: no exp and for another tenant is malformed
the signature is checked before the payload is read: a forged payload that is not JSON is bad_signature
a fractional exp
exp true
nbf true
a ticket missing a claim other than exp and nbf is still valid
a ticket with no iss is wrong_audience
iss is compared exactly: upper case is wrong_audience
iss is compared exactly: a trailing slash is wrong_audience
a null crit is still a crit
a kid the reader holds no key for, signed by a key it holds
a signature one byte short is bad_signature
an empty payload part is undecodable
